description: This file defines the styling for the front-end application, including variables for light and dark themes, as well as styles for various elements such as the application header, logo, and theme toggle button.

classes.name: App
classes.description: The main application container with centering styles and responsive design for light and dark themes.

classes.name: App-header
classes.description: Header styling for the application, including background color, flexbox layout, and text properties.

classes.name: theme-toggle
classes.description: Styles for the theme toggle button, including positioning, background color, hover effects, and transitions.

methods.name: App-logo
methods.description: Styling for the application logo, including size and animation properties.

methods.name: App-link
methods.description: Styles for links in the application, with color and transition effects.
